'''Laria''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
[[File:LariaSaved.png|thumb|left|200px|Laria saved by the Jedi]]
In [[3643 BBY]], Laria, along with [[Tal (Taris)|Tal]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gatten Edaine]], was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was [[Destruction of Taris|ravaged]] three hundred years ago. She was part of an expedition that were assigned to work with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] to investigate the desolated swampland populated by [[rakghoul]]s. However, when most members of the expedition was killed with the exception of Tykan himself and a survey team, who had left before the attack, Laria and Tal were trapped under a large piece of debris before the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] arrived. After the Consular levitated Tal back to safety, Laria was the final surviving member of the expedition to be saved.
